title: VectorMap
intro: VectorMap renders SVG-based maps with interactive layers, supporting tooltips, click handlers, and custom styling for each region.
tables: Accessible name for the map (used in aria-label)
SVG viewBox attribute defining the coordinate system
Array of layer objects with id, name, and SVG path data (d)
Array<{ id: string; name: string; d: string }>
Function to compute props for each layer (className, onClick, hover)
Array of layer IDs that are checked/selected
Array of layer IDs that are currently active
Content to display in the tooltip on hover
CSS classes for the layer path
